question: Which Indian physicist shared the Boltzmann Medal for the year 2022 with American scientist John Hopfield?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepak Dhar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian physicist **Deepak Dhar** shared the prestigious **Boltzmann Medal** in 2022 with American scientist John Hopfield.
 
• This award recognizes significant contributions to statistical mechanics.
 
• His work focuses on phase transitions and complex systems in statistical mechanics.
